## Density

**More on screen in the apps you pick**, like Android's display density setting. The app lays itself out for a bigger screen, so lists, feeds and pages fit more, while the status bar and keyboard stay exactly as they are.

- **Simple:** Settings → Density. Set the **Amount** slider (0 is normal, 30 fits the most), then switch Density on for the apps you want.
- **Stock look:** the keyboard and status bar are untouched, and text stays sharp.
- **Light:** apps you don't switch on load nothing extra.
- Changed something? Tap **Apply Changes**: it closes the apps you changed and resprings.

- **Keyboard fix:** chat boxes and text bars should no longer hide behind the keyboard (reported in Messenger, Discord, WhatsApp, Telegram, Narwhal, WeChat and X DMs). They now sit right on top of it, with or without the predictive bar, at any Amount. The keyboard itself stays stock.
- Tested in Reddit, Messages and the Reynard browser on iOS 15.8 (iPhone 7) and iOS 16.7 (iPhone 8 Plus). If a chat app still hides its box, or you're on iOS 17 or 18, please [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- **arm64 and arm64e** (A12 and newer) builds, made with Xcode's toolchain and checked for the correct arm64e format.
- Tested on an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11)** with iOS 16.7 and an **iPhone 7 (A10)** with iOS 15.8.6, with Dopamine, in Settings, Notes, X, YouTube and Reddit, up to an Amount of 30. Reported working on an **iPhone 15 Pro Max (A17 Pro) with iOS 17.3** and an **iPhone SE (2nd gen) with iOS 18.2**; more reports welcome: [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues). If it puts you into safe mode, open Sileo (safe mode still allows it) and uninstall it.

- **Beta.** Games aren't tested yet. If an app looks wrong, switch it off.
- Needs **AltList** and **PreferenceLoader** (Sileo installs them).
- Only for rootless jailbreaks (Dopamine).
Written from scratch by **John d_ie**. Inspired by Android's display density (DPI) setting.
